description: This file defines the Deviations class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, implementing statistical deviation functions such as sumSquares (DEVSQ), kurtosis, and skewness.

classes.name: Deviations
classes.description: Provides statistical deviation functions such as sumSquares (DEVSQ), kurtosis, and skewness.

methods.name: sumSquares
methods.description: Calculates the sum of squares of deviations of data points from their sample mean, corresponding to the DEVSQ Excel function.

methods.name: kurtosis
methods.description: Calculates the kurtosis of a data set, indicating peakedness of the distribution.

methods.name: skew
methods.description: Calculates the skewness of a distribution, assessing asymmetry.
